method: Inline bash measurement; N=10 each config back-to-back; trim-2 mean ± σ; warmup before each config.

interpretation.verdict: NULL on M5 — cache eviction is not a viable Week 3 lever.
interpretation.detail: Nominal -107 MB direction matches the original Day 2 reading on stale build/ binary. Signal at 0.19σ pooled is indistinguishable from environmental noise; 95% CI ~ ±1100 MB. Both runs hit identical v3_arena (5570 MB deterministic) confirming v3-level state is invariant; the peak variance is OS-level page-eviction noise.
interpretation.elsewhere_anomaly: Both configs show elsewhere=0 MB. HNE_BUCKET_DECOMP claimed ~990 MB elsewhere on HNE; today's builddir/ shows 0 across HNE + M5. The elsewhere-counter may be broken in current builddir/, OR the bucket genuinely shrank between binaries. Separate investigation; not blocking Week 3 decision.
